data: Which line has the highest value at 2 attractors?

The green line represents the Linzen's supervised model, which has the highest value at 2 attractors. The red line represents the Linzen's Google LM model, and the blue line represents the Our LSTM LM model. At 2 attractors, the green line is above both the red and blue lines. Therefore, the green line has the highest value at 2 attractors.
